values.note: Operator's rates page: 30/20-amp water/electric $50/night, 50/30/20-amp $65; holidays $60 / $75; weekly $315 / $410; monthly $975 / $1,250; seasonal (May-October, select sites, waitlist) $3,250. Cabins $110. Rates cover 6 people; extra adults and kids over 2 $5/night. CampLife's estimates add $10 once per stay.
